newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel to allow imports from Qatar and Oman.
newsitem.headline: Israel to allow imports from Qatar and Oman.

text.p: Israel's Industry and Trade Ministry said on Wednesday that it had dropped a ban on imports from Qatar and Oman.
Zohar Perry, head of the ministry's foreign trade division, told Reuters that the decision followed requests from Israeli businessmen who want to import building products.
Perry said imports would still be subject to a list of approved products to be released later. The ministry said the move would enable bilateral trade to develop.
Israel has what Perry termed an unofficial economic representative in Oman.
Perry said Israel maintained a ban on imports from Arab countries, except Egypt, Jordan, Morocco and Tunisia. He said Israel had no plans to lift the ban on any other countries.
